Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 24 (test build)

Release 24 makes reconnecting after a restore or a key change more reliable, and lets your phone list requests still waiting.

Status

Status
Active
Published
2026-10-29
End date
Not set

The current release. New vaults are enrolled into it, and the app offers it to everyone on an older release.

Changes

  • A connection that could not reconnect after the other side changed its keys now reconnects. Before, every retry was refused and the connection was lost for good.
  • Reconnecting after a restore, and two people reconnecting at the same moment, now end with one working connection. If a connection shows signs of being restored from an older copy, the vault pauses it and tells you.
  • If the new keys after a recovery could not be made, the vault now remembers that and tries again at your next unlock, instead of dropping it.
  • Your phone can now ask the vault for the sign-in, approval and other requests still waiting. They are kept through a lock, a hold or a restart.
  • Sign-in and approval requests now say what they are for, and the vault keeps the two kinds apart.
  • Built from vettid-vault commit 214b88f (tag release/staging/24) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-29 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
